prompts.typing: Edit target image 1: the EXISTING Claude typing sprite sheet. Image 2 is the same Claude's approved visual style. Correct ONLY the typing action, preserve orange palette and original character identity and three gray chunky keyboard keycaps. Wide terracotta rectangular slab with beveled top-left, two tall black rectangle eyes, four block feet, two small square orange hands. NO mouth, no cheeks, no new features. A professional crisp pixel-art 8-frame LOOPING TYPING sprite sheet, strict 4 columns by 2 rows, equal square cells on a square transparent canvas. Every character centered with same scale and same floor baseline, ample margins. In ALL EIGHT FRAMES both hands MUST remain on or immediately touching the three gray keycaps, near the very BOTTOM edge of the body. Both arms hang DOWN from the body, elbows never lifted, hands never near face or above bottom of torso. No hand waving, no fist raising, no pointing, no scratching. Tiny tapping movements only: fingers represented by block hands, left/right alternate pressure, depressing corresponding key 2-3 pixels and returning just to key surface. Frame1 both hands rest on keys; F2 left presses, right rests; F3 left releases still touching key, right presses; F4 right releases still touching key, left presses middle key; F5 both rest; F6 right presses right key; F7 left presses left key; F8 returns to F1. Keyboard, torso and feet remain fixed in EVERY frame. Only low hands and key pressure change. Use image1 FIRST FRAME as template for all frames; remove all raised-hand poses. Transparent background, no shadows, glow, effects, text or gridlines.
